caption: The video captures a grass fire already burning across a field of dry, tan vegetation. A bright arc of orange-yellow flames runs along the lower edge of a dark, charred and smoldering patch of scorched ground. A second flame line curves up the left side of that patch, licking at the standing grass. Thick grey-white smoke billows upward and drifts toward the upper-left corner, partially veiling the background. The flames continuously flicker, change height, and re-ignite in small tongues, while the overall fire boundary stays roughly in place. Along the smoky edges, occasional small flame tongues appear and fade without rearranging the surrounding layout of the field. A dirt track with a few tiny distant figures remains visible along the very top edge of the frame.
